modalities.evidence: Functional: A standard 6 minutes resting-state scan

output.population: 4 human participants, ages 29–50; artificially split into control and patient groups
output.summary: Test dataset for the Connectomix software: defaced T1w anatomical and six-minute resting-state functional scans from four participants, plus fMRIPrep and Connectomix derivatives. The control/patient grouping is artificial and serves testing only.
